text:
elaine: heads up — NovaHealth reported a schema break after last night's rollout. Their downstream JSON parser started failing when our response object suddenly wrapped the expected fields in a single string under \"result\". They see their usual keys (patientId, diagnosis, notes) present but inside a JSON string, e.g. \"result\": \"{\\\"patientId\\\": \\\"123\\\", ...}\".

mike: ah. do we know which rollout id?

elaine: deploy-bot logged: rollout-20260314-219 -> canary 2% @ 02:12 UTC, ramp to 100% @ 03:05 UTC. Customer says failures started ~03:20 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollout-20260314-219 promoted to 100% at 2026-03-14T03:05:12Z (initiator: aamir).

jess: quick hypothesis — model output around structured output combiners changed. maybe function-calling -> structured-output normalization bug serialized full object as string.

ryan: observed same pattern in console: error-rate for route /v1/complete/structured-output jumped from 0.2% -> 12% at 03:18. Most failures are parser errors downstream (json.decoder.JSONDecodeError).

mike: can you paste a failing example from the customer? need to reproduce.

elaine: pasted payload they get:```json
{
  "result": "{\"patientId\": \"123\", \"diagnosis\": \"flu\", \"notes\": [{\"t\": \"2026-03-14T02:58Z\", \"txt\": \"mild fever\"}]}"
}
```

jess: compare that to expected:```json
{
  "patientId": "123",
  "diagnosis": "flu",
  "notes": [{"t": "2026-03-14T02:58Z", "txt": "mild fever"}]
}
```

mike: interesting — output hasn't lost data, just stringified the sub-object and shoved it under a wrapper key. that smells like the post-processing pass that enforces top-level schema got applied incorrectly (wrapping everything under a \"result\" field).

elaine: customer included repro curl to our hosted API:```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-prod-2","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"return JSON with fields patientId, diagnosis, notes as array"},{"role":"user","content":"summarize patient 123"}], "stream": false}'
```

ryan: i pulled the request logs for that key — same model variant redwood-chat-prod-2. Model version tag on logs: v20260314-219.

mike: can reproduce locally with same payload and model variant in staging? jess do you want to try running the post-processor locally?

jess: i'll spin up postproc with v20260314-219 and run the sample. quick note: we merged a refactor to structured-output normalizer that switched to a safe-serialize path to avoid accidental JSON injection. culprit might be an extra serialize() call.

elaine: customer is blocked — they said pipeline dropped 18% of records in the last hour. They've asked for rollback or hotfix.

aamir: rollback request acknowledged. what's impact of rolling back to previous rollout-20260307-115?

mike: previous variant didn't include the new normalizer. rollback to -115 will restore old behavior. however need product signoff for rollback to prod.

elaine: customer asks ETA. we need to be fast.

jess: i can push a hotfix to postproc to skip the extra stringify for structured-output routes. test in canary (2%) first. if tests pass, we can promote.

ryan: oncall approves canary hotfix test. i'll monitor error-rate + parser success metrics.

aamir: prioritize hotfix > rollback? customer prefers immediate fix over rollback if safe. aamir -> i'll ping legal for change note but ok to proceed.

mike: plan: jess deploy hotfix as canary 2% under rollout-20260314-219-hotfix; observe 15m, if error-rate drops to baseline, promote. if not, rollback to -115.

elaine: i've informed customer of plan and asked them to hold off any client-side work. they appreciate the quick follow-up :thumbsup:. will update ticket with logs and timelines.

jess: starting deploy now, pushing hotfix image -> tag rollout-20260314-219-hotfix.

deploy-bot: initiating canary rollout rollout-20260314-219-hotfix at 2026-03-14T04:12:03Z (canary 2%).

ryan: monitoring dashboards. initial 5m look shows parser-failures down to 1.5% for canary. will keep watching.

elaine: thanks team. if hotfix holds we'll promote and close customer escalation. also logging action item for postmortem: make structured-output serializer idempotent and add unit test for double-serialize path.
